claims: As of March 2026, COVID-19 symptoms are driven by new, highly mutated variants such as the 'Cicada' (BA.3.2) and Stratus strains.
The Cicada variant (BA.3.2) has 70–75 mutations in the spike protein.
The Stratus variant is known to cause significant throat-related symptoms.
The Stratus variant causes specifically a very raspy or hoarse voice.
Hoarseness or raspy voice is specifically associated with the Stratus variant.
Severe sore throat is often described as sharp or "razor-like".
Congestion and runny nose involve heavy sinus pressure and nasal congestion.
Dry cough is a persistent, non-productive cough.
Loss of taste or smell is still possible with COVID-19.
Loss of taste or smell is less frequently the primary symptom compared to earlier in the pandemic.
Most people recover in 5 to 10 days.
Cough and fatigue can linger after recovery.
